svg.title: Quantizing both operands changes the scale product
svg.desc: Weight codes [2, −3] at scale 0.1 reconstruct [0.2, −0.3]. Activation codes [4, 5] at scale 0.2 reconstruct [0.8, 1]. Integer dot is 2 × 4 − 3 × 5 = −7. Multiplying by 0.1 × 0.2 gives −0.14, matching the reconstructed float dot. Actual accumulation depends on the kernel.

g.text: Nonzero zero points require offsets inside the products.
